messages.text: I'm Guildford! Yes, that Guildford. I'm sure you've heard of me!
messages.zh: 我是 Guildford! 没错，就是那个 Guildford。你肯定听说过我!

messages.text: There is some fantastic scenery around this land. I like to race back and forth!
messages.gloss: around this land 是「这一带、各处」，「这片土地周围」指的是它外面那一圈，正好是没有风景的地方。
messages.zh: 这一带风景相当不错，我就爱在这儿来回跑!
messages.raw: §fThere is some fantastic scenery around this land. I like to race back and forth!

messages.text: You can speak to me any time and I'll set up a race with the settings you choose.
messages.zh: 随时都可以来找我，我会按照你选择的设置安排竞速。
messages.raw: §fYou can speak to me any time and I'll set up a race with the settings you choose.

messages.text: If you do well in the races I will reward you!
messages.zh: 如果你在竞速中表现出色，我会奖励你!
messages.raw: §fIf you do well in the races I will reward you!
